Description: Successful vaccination of susceptible individuals at rate e_i * nu(t)
Ineffective vaccination of susceptible individuals at rate (1 - e_i) * nu(t)
Infection of susceptible individuals at the age-dependent force of infection lambda_i
Development of vaccine-induced protection at rate gamma
Infection of vaccinated but not yet protected individuals at force of infection lambda_i
Infection of ineffectively vaccinated individuals at force of infection lambda_i
Progression from latent to infectious state at rate kappa
Hospitalization of infectious individuals at age-specific rate alpha_i
Recovery of infectious individuals at rate gamma_1
Recovery of hospitalized individuals at rate gamma_2
Death of hospitalized individuals at age-specific mortality rate delta_i

Name: kappa
Description: Rate of progression from latent to infectious state (1/kappa is the mean latent period)

Name: gamma_1
Description: Recovery rate for infectious class (range 1/4 to 1)

Name: gamma_2
Description: Recovery rate for hospitalized class (range 1/4 to 1)

Name: alpha_i
Description: Age-specific hospitalization rate derived from probability of hospitalization given clinical illness

Name: delta_i
Description: Age-specific influenza mortality rate for hospitalized individuals derived from case fatality proportion

Name: q
Description: Transmission probability per contact, constant across age groups

Name: beta_ij
Description: Transmission rate between age groups i and j, product of transmission probability and age-specific contact rate

Name: R0
Description: Basic reproduction number for the 2009 H1N1 pandemic in Mexico

Name: e_i
Description: Age-specific vaccine efficacy (77.5% for <65y, 35% for >=65y)

Name: gamma
Description: Rate at which successfully vaccinated individuals develop protection (mean 10 days)

Name: nu(t)
Description: Vaccination rate, applied t* days after epidemic onset

Name: vaccination_coverage
Description: Vaccination coverage with full course of 1-2 doses

Name: t*
Description: Time after epidemic onset when vaccination is initiated
